title: Blue Harbor Retail: replacement tracking
transcript:
Agent: Blue Harbor support, this is Noah. How can I help?
Customer: Hi Noah, this is Dana from Blue Harbor Retail. I am checking on the replacement for order BH-7734. We sent the photos but have not received tracking.
Agent: Let me look at ticket T-3001. I see the photos were added on June 15. The replacement was approved and packed on June 17. It is scheduled to leave the warehouse today.
Customer: Can you confirm the shipping address? We have two docks and the replacement needs to go to the main one.
Agent: The order shows the main dock address. I will add a note to the ticket to make sure the carrier uses the main dock.
Customer: Good. When will it arrive?
Agent: The estimate is June 21 to June 23. I will email the tracking number as soon as it is generated. The follow-up is still set for June 22.
Customer: Perfect. And the damaged units? Do you need them back?
Agent: No, the warehouse does not need them returned. You can dispose of them safely.
Customer: That is easier. Thanks for checking.
Agent: You are welcome. I will send the tracking update today.
